external_entities.name: Ethereum Network
external_entities.description: The Ethereum mainnet or testnet where Berlin hardfork is coordinated
external_entities.trust_rationale: The consensus network itself; trusted as the authoritative coordination mechanism

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Peer node broadcasting blocks over the P2P network
external_entities.trust_rationale: P2P network peers could be malicious; blocks must be independently validated

external_entities.name: EIP Authors
external_entities.description: Authors proposing individual EIPs for Berlin inclusion
external_entities.trust_rationale: EIP authors go through review process but proposals still need validation and approval

external_entities.name: Block Producer
external_entities.description: Entity producing blocks and calculating blob fees
external_entities.trust_rationale: Block producers are economically incentivized validators but their blocks are still validated by all nodes

external_entities.name: Network Peer
external_entities.description: Peer node providing block for validation
external_entities.trust_rationale: Network peers could broadcast invalid blocks; full validation is required

external_entities.name: Calling Contract
external_entities.description: Smart contract invoking alt_bn128 precompiles for cryptographic operations
external_entities.trust_rationale: Smart contracts can be deployed by anyone; precompiles must validate input regardless of caller

external_entities.name: Untrusted Caller Input
external_entities.description: Input data from potentially malicious caller contract
external_entities.trust_rationale: Explicitly named as untrusted; input data must be fully validated

external_entities.name: Untrusted Data Source
external_entities.description: External entity providing data that requires cryptographic verification (network peer, user, RPC client)
external_entities.trust_rationale: Explicitly named as untrusted; any data from external sources requires hash verification

misclassified_entities.name: Hash Function Caller
misclassified_entities.description: Any internal component (transaction validation, state root computation, etc.) requesting a keccak256 hash
misclassified_entities.reason: Explicitly described as 'internal component'. Hash callers are within the system boundary, not external entities.

misclassified_entities.name: Hash512 Function Caller
misclassified_entities.description: Internal component requesting a keccak512 hash (used in specific protocols like Ethash)
misclassified_entities.reason: Explicitly described as 'internal component'. This is within the system boundary.
